programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. FC Porto – Rangers FC
programme.desc: The Dragons from Porto lost two points in the previous round in Pilzno and dropped out of the top eight, which is guaranteed to take part in the 1/8 finals. They can return to it because their loss is minimal, but they must prove to be better than Rangers, who have already lost their chance to advance to the next part of the competition.

programme.title: UEFA Europa League archive: Juventus Turin – Lech Poznań 16/09/2010 – 2010/2011 season
programme.desc: episode. In the program, viewers will see fragments of memorable matches played in the UEFA Europa League. From the 2009/2010 season, this competition replaced the previous UEFA Cup. The authors pay special attention to matches involving Polish clubs. The first Polish team to win the right to play in the LE group stage was Lech Poznań, later Wisła Kraków and Legia Warszawa also achieved this feat. The greatest success so far was promotion to the 1/16 finals of Lech in the 2010/2011 season, Legia and Wisła in the 2011/2012 season and Legia Warszawa in the 2014/2015 season

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. Panathinaikos AO – AS Roma
programme.desc: Rafael Benitez's team will host the team from Rome in the last, eighth round of the league phase of the current edition of the Europa League. The Clovers face a difficult challenge, because AS Roma is impressive in its form in European cups, winning the previous four matches, including the last one against VfB Stuttgart (2-0). Panathinaikos AO has also not lost in four matches, but in its case it is divided into two wins and draws. In the previous match, the Greek team drew with Ferencvaros (1:1)

programme.title: UEFA Europa League archive: Lech Poznań – FC Salzburg 30/09/2010 – 2010/2011 season

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. Aston Villa FC – FC Salzburg
programme.desc: The hosts are impressive in their form both domestically and in European cups. In the current edition of the Europa League, they lost only once - to Go Ahead Eagles (1-2), but since then they have won four in a row, including the last one over Fenerbahce (1-0). Aston Villa is already certain of promotion, taking second place in the table. The situation of the Austrians is definitely more difficult. RB Salzburg managed to win only two games and lost five. It takes a distant 28th place in the classification, and in order to advance to the play-off phase of the 1/16 finals, it must win in Birmingham and count on its rivals' mistakes.

programme.title: Football: Conference League. AZ Alkmaar – Jagiellonia Białystok
programme.desc: The pride of Podlasie, despite a 1-2 defeat against Rayo Vallecano in the previous round, can still finish in the top 8 at the end of the regular phase of the Conference League, and as a result, directly advance to the 1/8 finals. However, it must defeat away AZ Alkmaar, currently the sixth team in the Dutch Eredivisie, and also count on favorable results in other matches

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Omonia FC – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: The Medals are one of three teams in the Conference League that have not yet been defeated in the regular round. The Częstochowa team has already secured their place in the knockout phase, but they do not intend to be satisfied with that. They are counting on direct promotion to the 1/8 finals, which will give them a place in the best eight at the end of the league phase of the competition. Before the clash with Omonia, coached by former Legia coach Henning Berg, they are in third place in the table. The team from Nicosia is fifteenth and has eight points, three less than Raków

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Legia Warszawa – Lincoln Red Imps FC
programme.desc: Fans of Legia Warsaw want to forget about the autumn round as soon as possible. The military will start the winter break as the penultimate team in the PKO BP Ekstraklasa table. However, they still have the last match in the Conference League, in which they have no chance of advancing to the knockout phase. However, they will want to end 2025 with a victory against Lincoln Red Imps FC

programme.title: Football: Conference League – play-off match: KuPS Kuopio – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: To join Raków in the 1/8 finals of the Conference League, Kolejorz must defeat the Finnish champion in two matches. However, if he plays as poorly as he did against Piast Gliwice (0:1) or Lechia Gdańsk (1:3) in the opening round of the spring round of Ekstraklasa, it will be difficult for him

programme.title: Football: Conference League – play-off match: Jagiellonia Białystok – ACF Fiorentina
programme.desc: The pride of Podlasie will face the highest-ranked participant in this edition of the Conference League in the UEFA ranking. However, he has no chance in the two-legged match, as his opponent is in a serious crisis. The purple team in Serie A are fighting to get out of the relegation zone

programme.title: Football: Conference League - second leg play-off match: HNK Rijeka - Omonia FC
programme.desc: HNK Rijeka returned from Cyprus a week ago with a one-goal advantage. The only goal in this match was scored by Daniel Adu Adjei in the 86th minute. Will Omonia manage to make up for the losses on the opponent's pitch and advance to the 1/8 finals of the Conference League?

programme.desc: In his sixth professional fight, undefeated Jonny Mansour will face the experienced Marco Antonio Juarez. The Mexican lost his last three fights. The American has a good chance to continue his winning streak

programme.desc: In the main event of the gala in Las Vegas, we will see the fight between Jai Opetaia and Brandon Glanton. The Australian boasts a record of 24-5. In turn, his rival has 21 victories, with as many as 18 fights ending with a knockout

programme.desc: chronicle

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Legia Warszawa – Cracovia
programme.desc: The victory against Wisła Płock and the draw against Jagiellonia on a difficult terrain in Białystok brought some encouragement to the hearts of the Warsaw team's fans. Although the Army is still in the red zone, if they score points regularly, they can quickly leave it. A win against Cracovia, which last won the league on February 2, will be a signal that Marek Papszun's team is heading in the right direction.

programme.title: Ski jumping: Junior World Championships – Lillehammer 2026 – team competition
programme.desc: During this year's championship, the favorites for gold are the Austrian representatives, led by Stephan Embacher. The 20-year-old in Lillehammer stood on the highest step of the podium during the individual competition, beating, among others, Kacper Tomasiak

programme.title: Winter Paralympic Games Milan-Cortina 2026: Alpine paraskiing - women's and men's super-G
programme.desc: In the super-G, we keep our fingers crossed for Michał Gołości's successful runs. The Pole has won World Championship medals in slalom, giant slalom and alpine combined. Now he will try to win the Olympic medal

programme.title: Hokej: NHL: Buffalo Sabres – Tampa Bay Lightning
programme.desc: The previous clash between these teams ended with a 6-2 victory for the Sabers. Now the team from Buffalo wants to repeat this result and thus strengthen itself in the top three of the NHL's Eastern Conference

programme.title: Men's Basketball: NBA: Los Angeles Lakers - New York Knicks
programme.desc: The previous clash between these teams ended with a victory for the New York Knicks 112:100. Now New Yorkers will try to repeat this result. Polish fans hope to see Jeremy Sochan in action, who joined the third team of the Eastern Conference in mid-February

programme.title: Wild New Zealand | S01E02
programme.desc: A three-episode documentary revealing the secrets of the flora and fauna of the remote islands of New Zealand, the last land discovered and inhabited by humans. For 80 million years, life went on there in its own strange way. With the arrival of people, new species of animals arrived there, such as merino, ermine, and kakapo, the only flightless species of parrot in the world, found only there. In the far corner of the Pacific Ocean lies New Zealand, cut off from the rest of the world since the time of the dinosaurs. Fauna and flora developed here in a unique way. In this lost world, nature has special rules: penguins in the forest, parrots in the snow and predators as if taken straight from prehistoric times. Representatives of flora and fauna must struggle with the geological forces that have provided the beauty of this land. Here you can meet pioneers conquering mountain peaks, dolphins emerging from the depths of the sea, and birds hunting with masterful agility over hot streams. Great Britain. 2016. documentary film

programme.title: Wild Vienna
programme.desc: Vienna is one of the most biologically active cities in the world. It is in the capital of Austria that you can see wildlife almost everywhere. The island of Donauinsel, located on the Danube, is designed to protect against flooding and is also a recreational area... Germany. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: The Wild East of Poland
programme.desc: The documentary focuses on one of the last wild regions in Europe, the Biebrza Valley. The largest National Park in Poland is a habitat for beavers, otters and a whole host of water birds... Germany, Poland. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: Australia: animal rescue – Jack – rhomboid python | E02
programme.desc: Dr Bree and her team at Byron Bay Wildlife Hospital rescue Australian animals in need of help. They treat a variety of creatures, from tiny echidnas to koalas and kangaroos. A diamond python named Jack had a bad encounter with a tractor and needs urgent surgery. Prickles the echidna was hit by a car. Dr. Bree needs to fix her dislocated paw. Australia. 2021. documentary series

programme.title: Texas: Alligator Rescue – Family Matters | E03
programme.desc: Gator Country researchers, experts and interns educate viewers about alligators. Their task is to save those predators that have left their habitats and gotten lost. Then they move the animals to a reserve where they can function peacefully... USA. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 3 – Electric Monster | S03E05
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade travels the world and looks at the strangest, most terrifying fish that inhabit rivers. He talks to people who survived the encounter with water monsters. Jeremy goes to Brazilian. USA. 2011. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Summer | E04
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Summer is a time of plenty for most animals - but not for polar bears. These predators cannot hunt seals until the sea freezes over. They are getting hungrier every day. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Face to face – Orcas | E03
programme.desc: Rodolphe Guignard is a photographer and diver. He travels the world to meet predators and come face to face with them. He will see orcas, crocodiles, sharks and people living next to these majestic animals up close... France. 2024. documentary series

programme.desc: Dr Bree and her team at Byron Bay Wildlife Hospital rescue Australian animals in need of help. They treat a variety of creatures, from tiny echidnas to koalas and kangaroos. She's reigned over two square miles of prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for ten years. But now she's in trouble. At thirteen years old, Kamuti is one of the oldest leopards in the African bush, and she's not as effective a hunter as she used to be. Kamuti's problems are compounded by her neighbours, the Nsefu pride of lions, who steal her kills and attack her on sight. The film follows Kamuti over three days as she struggles to find a meal, while trying to avoid her neighbours from hell. As well as Kamuti's daytime struggles, a revolutionary thermal camera allows us to see in the dark and reveals the secret world of these enigmatic, nocturnal predators | Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc: Its origin in the foothills of the Rockies is hardly known, but from there the huge Mississippi feeds a vast network of headwaters and tributaries. These run through the USA from the Rocky Mountains in the west to the Appalachian mountain range in the far east. After the water meets the Mississippi River, it flows south into the Gulf of Mexico. \n\nThis documentary by Simon Blakeney tells the story of this fascinating lifeline of the United States. The Mississippi is illuminated from all sides. The result is an elaborate BBC production with special recordings of the interaction between nature, wildlife and people.

programme.title: The largest rivers in the world
programme.desc:
Fascinating water world! Africa's fourth-longest river meanders over 2,574 kilometers from its source on the border with the Democratic Republic of Congo until it flows into the Indian Ocean in Mozambique. On the way there, you will be amazed by the gigantic Victoria Falls, which have been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1989. Here the mighty river falls at a width of 1,708 meters into a gorge approximately 110 meters deep. Until it flows into the Indian Ocean, the Zambezi crosses Angola, Zambia, forms borders with Namibia and Zimbabwe and ends in Mozambique. The people along its banks live with its rhythm: floods bring fertile soil and secure agriculture.

Further stages: Batoka Gorge and Lake Kariba.

programme.title: NHỮNG HỘ VỆ CUỐI CÙNG - THE LAST DEFENDERS (S2)

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người đang làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời dùng thử sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: ĐIỆP VỤ ĐẢO QUỶ - OPERATION BANGKOK
programme.desc: Cựu quân nhân Wu và cảnh sát chìm Ming giải cứu con tin trên một hòn đảo gần Bangkok. Ngay khi nhiệm vụ hoàn thành và họ chuẩn bị rời đi, Wu phát hiện ra con gái mình cũng đã bị bắt. Quyết tâm cứu cô, anh ở lại cùng Ming để chiến đấu với bọn côn đồ và giải cứu cô.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: TRÒ CHƠI ĐOẠT MẠNG - ELIMINATION GAME
programme.desc: Hải quân SEAL Rick bị kết án thối rữa trong nhà tù quân sự cho đến khi anh ta có cơ hội đặt cược mạng sống của mình và giành được tự do trong một chương trình thực tế giết hoặc bị giết. Rick sẽ phải loại bỏ một số kẻ giết người khét tiếng nhất thế giới trên truyền hình trực tiếp để giành được tự do và minh oan cho mình. Liệu cuối cùng anh ấy có thể thành công?

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. programme.desc: Đặc vụ Lực lượng Đặc biệt Brenner và chồng cô tình cờ phát hiện ra một tổ hợp ma túy bất hợp pháp trong rừng khi đang đi bộ đường dài. Những kẻ buôn ma túy bắt họ, giết chồng cô và bỏ mặc cô cho đến chết. Brenner không chỉ thoát chết mà còn nổi cơn thịnh nộ và thề sẽ truy lùng tất cả những kẻ đã sát hại chồng mình và trả thù!
